recommendation_summary: Right now the reply recommends one January session: add a phone-calendar event for each contract dated 14 days before its notice deadline, with the renewal date and notice method in the notes. It also offers to format the list if the user pastes this year's statement. It rejects the whole n8n, Gmail-agent, vector-database and Telegram stack and suggests no extra tools now. It leaves two needs unmet: it doesn't say how to check that calendar notifications are switched on, and it doesn't mention repeating the step from next year's statement.
note: The reply makes a sound SMALL recommendation but has none of the four labelled record lines, so every record-based predicate fails.
